findings.title: Lockfile update method unevidenced (spec, AC6)
findings.problem: The spec and AC6 require the lockfile to be updated package by package, never regenerated. package-lock.json changed across five commits, but none of its hunks were in the frozen review diff. Only the resolved versions (vite 8.3.1, vitest 5.0.2, keycloakify 11.15.14, @a2ui/markdown-it 0.1.1) could be spot-checked, so the required method is only partially met.
findings.impact: A regenerated lockfile silently re-resolves unrelated transitive dependencies across the whole tree. That is a supply-chain and runtime-regression risk the requirement exists to prevent. Reachability is unconfirmed: the method could not be established from the available input.
findings.recommendation: Provide evidence that the lockfile diff (origin/main..HEAD -- package-lock.json) only touches the targeted packages and their required transitive entries. If unrelated entries moved, restore them from origin/main and re-apply the upgrades package by package.

findings.title: getMode build-time fallback no longer tested
findings.problem: The test that asserted getMode() returns 'local' via the build-time fallback (window._env_.VITE_ENV empty -> import.meta.env.VITE_ENV, src/utils/utils.ts:62) now stubs VITE_ENV to '' and expects ''. The neighbouring test named for the fallback sets window._env_.VITE_ENV='development', so it never reaches it. No test now tells the fallback apart from a plain return of window._env_.VITE_ENV. Runtime code is unchanged; this is a broken-verification gap the change introduced.
findings.impact: Local-mode detection depends on this fallback: getMode() === ENV.LOCAL in src/store/auth.ts:90 and the dev user-id header in src/utils/api.ts:438. A regression in the fallback would pass the suite unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Keep the '' case, and add or restore a case that sets window._env_ = { VITE_ENV: '', VITE_API_URL: '' }, runs vi.stubEnv('VITE_ENV', 'local') and expects getMode() to be 'local'. Also rename or fix the misnamed 'import.meta.env.VITE_ENV' test so it actually exercises the fallback.
